propositions: The bridge command surface unifies fragmented Jira-specific operators into one provider-neutral Python-first interface with canonical verbs: setup, check-access, fsck, status, preview, sync, pause, and resume.
Argument-less reconcile remains non-mutating dry-run for compatibility; argument-less bridge sync is the canonical mutating command with explicit adapter implementation.
Canonical exit codes are 0, 1, and 2; legacy exit codes 3, 4, and 75 are preserved through compatibility adapters for older workflows.
The same Python library core is shared across CLI (rebar bridge), Python library imports, and MCP server interfaces with no private reimplementation per surface.
Pause state is remote-persisted, includes a reason field, and remains readable by mixed-version fleets without GitHub gh CLI dependency for destructive repair.

All three install paths (brew, pip, MCP-server) execute the same packaged Python implementation without requiring editable checkouts or ambient Python; tickets-branch delivery is Python-owned in src/rebar/_store/push.py.
